description: This PHP source file defines the class CalendarEventConflictResolver, which handles conflict resolution logic for syncing calendar events between internal and external sources. It includes methods for determining which event to keep during conflicts based on timestamps, external/internal priority, and content checks.

classes.name: CalendarEventConflictResolver
classes.description: A class that provides methods to determine which version of a calendar event should be used when conflicts arise during synchronization, based on timestamps, content, and priority rules.

methods.name: determineWinningEvent
methods.description: Main method to decide which event to keep during sync conflicts by applying predefined conflict resolution strategies.

methods.name: validateEventData
methods.description: Checks event data for security issues, timestamp validity, and suspicious content patterns.

methods.name: determineEarlySelection
methods.description: Early exit method to choose the target event if both events are identical in content checksum, avoiding further conflict resolution.

methods.name: resolveByTimestamp
methods.description: Resolves conflicts by selecting the event with the most recent modification timestamp, with microsecond precision and deterministic tie-breaker.

methods.name: resolveByExternalPriority
methods.description: Prioritizes external events when conflicts are detected, falling back to timestamp comparison when statuses are equal.

methods.name: resolveByInternalPriority
methods.description: Prioritizes internal events when conflicts are detected, falling back to timestamp comparison when statuses are equal.
